mapper.insert: INSERT INTO co_access_record ( target_type, target_id, user_id, workspace_id, access_time, last_accessed_at, access_type, access_duration, access_ip, user_agent, view_count, create_time ) VALUES ( #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, #{workspaceId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{accessType}, #{accessDuration}, #{accessIp}, #{userAgent}, 1, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access_time = NOW(), last_accessed_at = NOW(), workspace_id = VALUES(workspace_id), access_type = VALUES(access_type), access_duration = VALUES(access_duration), access_ip = VALUES(access_ip), user_agent = VALUES(user_agent), view_count = view_count + 1, update_time = NOW()
